reason: A multi-platform IM gateway that connects DeepSeek Harness agents to Feishu, Lark, WeCom, and Telegram while maintaining per-chat sessions and relaying messages.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体连接到飞书、Lark、企业微信和 Telegram，并为每个聊天维护会话上下文的多平台即时通信网关。
summaries.en: A multi-platform instant messaging gateway that connects DeepSeek Harness agents to Feishu, Lark, WeCom, and Telegram with per-chat conversation sessions.

capabilities: Connects DeepSeek Harness agents to Feishu, Lark, WeCom, and Telegram
Receives and sends chat messages through long polling, WebSocket, webhook, or HTTP callback adapters
Maintains serialized per-chat agent sessions and conversation context
Accepts external chat input that may cause the connected agent to execute host tools
Stores and uses messaging-platform credentials and access-control settings
